profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hello!

I am a recent graduate from New Jersey Institute of Technology with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.

I am highly motivated and interested in gaining as much experience as possible in software engineering with a focus on applications built for distributed systems. In addition, I also like to delve in the development of user interfaces for desktop application using software tools such as WxPython and Electron.

Over the years I have had the pleasure of coordinating several teams in software development projects using Agile Scrum mythologies participating both as a scrum master and team member; and business product solutions conferencing directly with bankers, lawyers and accounting firms for service delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: API Development · Docker · JavaScript · Linux · Python (Programming Language) · PostgreSQL · Symfony Framework · git · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Redevelop decades old application for the National Weather Service (NWS) under NOAA through a comprehensive lift & shift initiative. Serve as the primary liaison between the development team and the long-term support group, ensuring seamless coordination and alignment of objectives. This critical service enhances and streamlines the dissemination of weather forecasts for designated US authorities within specific geographic locations.

▪ Engaged with team members in Agile methodology (Scrum) holding daily sprint sessions for planning and reviewing application’s purposes.
▪ Researched, reviewed, and proposed improvements for existing system architecture.
▪ Architect, develop, and rigorously test REST API leveraging Symfony 5.4, API Platform, Postman, and curl on RHEL 8 machines to ensure optimal
performance and functionality.
▪ Engaged in the design, testing and functionality of SQL queries.
▪ Lead the redesign, development, and seamless integration of Python3 daemons for STQ and FWS product processing into NGITWS system.
▪ Provided guidance on NGITWS internal operational systems to teammates.
▪ Participate actively in peer code review sessions, fostering a collaborative environment and ensuring adherence to coding standards and best
practices.
▪ Proactively acquired proficiency in emerging technologies including Vue.js, LDM, MongoDB, NGITWS, Zabbix, GrayLog, NetCDF.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Symfony Framework · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · Zabbix · NetCDF · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · MongoDB · LDM · API Development · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer / Project Management
positions.description:
- Manage and coordinate shift composed of 4 members
- Distributed incoming job tasks among team members
- Report and log job activities to managing partners and executive employees
- Trained technical personnel on use of software (GoFiler, Microsoft Office, Adobe, Outlook)
- Attend live and virtual meetings with bankers, lawyers and accountants for product and service deliverable 
- Aid team members in EDGARizing HTML filings to comply with standards set by the Security Exchange Commission
-  Analyze best development approach for creation of parsing script for Commercial Mortage-Backed Securities (CMBS) schema

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Identified inefficient processes used in supply management. Approached managing partners and executive team with a design solution based on Python to automate the procedures. Held weekly meetings with future users on product and sprint backlog. By utilizing the new applications, the firm obtains better insights into supply usage and allocation. This results in fewer wasted resources and lower project delivery cost.

Project delivery
- Lead a 4 person engineering team to streamlined ingestion of CMBS files for business operations to meeting SLA's
- Engaged with team members in Agile methodology holding sprint sessions for planning and reviewing of application purpose
- Created communication method for easability of daily scrums
- Research, design and propose software architecture
- Led and managed internal development of 3-tier architecture desktop application
- Design application configuration files using JSON or YAML format 
- Developed user interface using cross-platform GUI library WxPython 4.0 – Phoenix
- Design and test RESTAPIs in PostMan and AWS API Gateway
- Participate in the design, testing and functionality of SQL queries.
- Rapid database prototyping using SQLite
- Use GitKraken and GitHub for version control

positions.title: VBA Scripter
positions.description:
Assisted data processing team by creating and implementing Python and VBA data cleansing scripts

- Increased file processing efficiency by 80% through development of MS Excel Add-in using VB script
- Created Excel and Outlook Macros
- Developed and updated automated script for charts, data tables and graphs on a weekly and monthly basis
- Provided technical support on queries related to MS Office suite tools
- Helped resolving database and spreadsheet application problems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with the business owner and on-site team to create a digital presence for her business. The strategy was divided into three stages. In the first stage, the business website was launched using a robust security system. In the second stage, the content management system was integrated with social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter. In the final stage, storage system was integrated to handle internal files.

    - Reviewed existing system architecture and recommended improvements
    - Launched AWS EC2 Linux instances, and created hosted zone in Route 53
    - Installed and configured web services like Apache2, Lets Encrypt, CertBot, MariaDB, and Nagios
    - Wrote Dockerfile and Docker-Compose files for tool integration testing
    - Created Bash scripts to automatically renew SSL certificate
    - Configured AWS Security Groups
    - Created and configured AWS IAM users, groups and roles
    - Helped Designed relational database model
    - Modified web template provided by client to suit its needs using JavaScript and PHP7
    - Responded to queries from owner and team members
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PHP · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Back End Engineer
positions.description:
- Assisted product owner with Agile Scrum methodology as a team member in development of sprint stories
- Assisted project manager on keeping track and status of sprint releases using Trello
- Forefront development of STEERus new member dashboard with vanilla PHP 7
- Front and back integration
- Performed version control of software releases using Git.
- Analyzed and studied MangoApps API suite tools for integration with STEERus platform
- Analyzed and studied scalability and usability of different cloud storage system
- Performed AWS S3 storage system integration with STEERus platform for file storage and retrival

positions.title: STEM Tutor - Computer Science
positions.description:
- Monitored usage of computer lab equipment
- Aided students with object oriented programming challenges in C++ and Python
- Assisted students with Microsoft Office and SQL
- Coordinated and lectured programming workshops in C++ and Python

projects.title: Personal Web Page
projects.description:
- Tech Stack: Vultr Cloud, Linux CentOS 7, Apache, Nagios, JavaScript, Bootstrap, PHP 7

The motivation of this project was to develop and host a personal website where I could present the different projects I have worked on and to develop small internal web applications for my personal use. Vultr is the hosting provided I chose for my site. I make use of their cloud computing platform with a CentOS instance. The site is built using a Model-view-controller, MVC, architecture and it was written using vanilla PHP 7, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. The page is served with an SSL certificate by an Apache web server and I decided to use Nagios as my server monitoring system.

projects.title: Self Hosted Cloud Migration
projects.description:
- Tech Stack: NextCloud, Duck DNS, IoT (Raspberry Pi 3B, Network Switch), 4TB HDD, Linux Ubuntu

The goal of this project is to create an independent and robust self hosted cloud system which allows the detachment of third-party cloud service providers like Google Drive and OneDrive. This empowers group members to secure and hone skills in different fields such networking, cybersecurity and Linux system administration. In addition, it extricates the storage size limitations imposed by third-parties providers. The biggest challenge yet met on this project was analyzing whether to designed and build a system tailor to our user goals, or integrate a set of per-existing open-source tools. The project makes use of open-source tools like NextCloud and Duck DNS, IoT and network hardware such as Raspberry Pi 3 model B,  a network switch, router and a 4TB HDD.
